issue.title: Finish sase-listen rollout on the Mac when it is online
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1g7.4, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1, and verified by sase-1g7.land: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 mac true still times out at kellys-macbook-pro.tail297af1.ts.net:22 on 2026-10-04. The approved plan explicitly made the Mac rollout best-effort while offline. athena and apollo are deployed and the full proof episode is delivered; no source change is needed for Mac support.

When the Mac is online, use a login shell to find uv/chezmoi and install the landed release source with uv tool install --force --reinstall git+https://github.com/sase-org/sase-listen (PyPI publication is still separately tracked by sase-1eh). Apply the managed config with chezmoi update -a --force; it declares feed.host=apollo, host_ssh=[apollo, apollo-do], and a portable ~/.local/share/sase-listen/feed directory. Check pass show gemini_cli_api_key >/dev/null without printing the key; configure a local secret if missing. Run sase-listen doctor and confirm feed:host points at apollo, then run sase-listen script https://openai.com/index/harness-engineering/ -e brief. If inherited Gemini API-key environment overrides are stale, use env -u GEMINI_API_KEY -u GOOGLE_API_KEY -u SASE_LISTEN_GEMINI_API_KEY so the configured pass command is used. Confirm the cached/generated script is lint-clean and feed --json sees the existing episodes. Do not publish another test episode or print the feed token/full subscription URL. Record the install and verification receipt in field notes.

Size small: the blocker is the offline laptop; this is a bounded install/config/doctor/script checklist using existing code and approved dotfiles. No duplicate in all-status searches or the last-week task sweep; no active epic caused the machine to be offline.

task_type_fields.proposal: Install the landed sase-listen and managed apollo-host config on the Mac, then verify doctor and a brief URL script.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved sase-1g7 plan made Mac rollout best-effort and required follow-up if offline; both attempts timed out, so completion depends on the laptop coming online.

issue.creation_reason: The Mac was unreachable during sase-1g7.4 and remains unreachable at landing. Its explicitly deferred deployment needs a durable owner after the URL/feed-host epic closes.

payload.description: Mac rollout installs from git until the separately tracked PyPI publication exists
